 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Hosts New Zealand will hope to conclude the T20I series on a high as they face off against India in the fifth and final T20I on Sunday.
 The Black Caps managed to avoid a whitewash following a dominant 87-run win in the fourth T20I in Auckland. Glenn Phillips' 107-run knock off 49 balls triggered the comeback, and Michael Bracewell followed up with an incredible 65-ball 65, along with four wickets by Jacob Duffy.
